name: Drone hyperlapse capture to Gaussian splat in free Splatware
goal: Capture overlapping multi-angle views of a building/subject with DJI built-in hyperlapse modes (photogrammetry-style coverage of every facade, slow flight to avoid blur, no paid flight planner), then upload the hyperlapse/video to the free Splatware web app, process, review, and download the Gaussian splat.

prerequisites: DJI drone with hyperlapse modes (e.g. Mavic Air 3)

inputs.name: building_or_subject
inputs.description: Target to cover from all facades

constraints: Use free Splatware web app from the tutorial

steps.action: Plan multi-angle coverage of every facade (photogrammetry-style).
steps.expect: Coverage plan includes all major facades

steps.action: Fly slowly; avoid blur; export media.
Run processing; review and download the splat.
steps.expect: Interactive splat viewable after processing; splat downloaded

verification: All major facades appear in capture
